name: 30605 · Athens, GA
findings: ZIP 30605 (Athens) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30605 (Athens) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 24 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: No hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
